comment: The gain knobs use the maker's centred dB scaling, two to the power minus two to the minus power over -1 to 1, which is zero at the centre of the travel and plus and minus one and a half at the ends (src/C.cpp:56-58 and 95-97). The mix is not attenuated: three channels at full gain add straight together, and the LINK input is added on top with no scaling at all (src/C.cpp:123-129). The low pass comes before the gain. The panel prints G1, F1, G2, F2, G3, F3, IN1, OUT1, IN2, OUT2, IN3, OUT3, LINK and MIX.
